QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Shows the AgriBoard debug controls that send MAV_CMDs to the Lua bridge.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sprayCommandId
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: SCRIPT_MESSAGE param1 value used for spray start/stop (sent via MAV_CMD_DO_SEND_SCRIPT_MESSAGE).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: scriptStartAction
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: SCRIPT_MESSAGE param1 value used to start the fixed-PWM mission bridge (default 20).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: scriptStopAction
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: SCRIPT_MESSAGE param1 value used to stop the fixed-PWM mission bridge (default 21).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: logLineLimit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Maximum number of log lines to keep in the AgriBoard debug console.
